items.text: No one is on screen except: Archie.
Exactly one person is in the image: Archie (the man from the sprite master), with no other people anywhere in the car park.
Archie's face, clothes and chunky low-detail shading match the Archie sprite master (same man, not a different character).
Archie is standing with his body facing the camera.
Both of Archie's hands are in his jacket pockets.
Archie's head is turned toward screen-right, not straight at the camera.
Archie's eyes look off toward the pay machine and far bays (screen-right), not at the viewer.
Archie's mouth shows an easy, relaxed smile.
Archie's brows are slightly drawn and his eyes narrowed, so he reads as alert and watchful rather than simply happy.
Archie is close to the camera and stands in the screen-left third of the frame, at the edge of the aisle beside the parked cars, not in the middle of the lane.
Archie's feet sit about four-fifths of the way down the image, with a soft contact shadow under them.
The trolley shelter is still small and far behind Archie, and the pay machine, lamppost, cars, buildings and red Orbit tower are where they are on the blank plate.
No buyer or second figure is arriving or visible anywhere, including in the distance.
No pearl, cash, banknotes or coins are visible, in Archie's hands or anywhere else.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
